description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1757/13, Rathmalana D/S Division  -  Cad. Map No. 520017 and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land parcel records, including changes to ownership details, encumbrances, land extents, and property boundaries across various locations in Sri Lanka. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations, title amendments, and property ownership details.
